title: Human Islets - Preprocessing
author: Opentrons
materials: Digest the islets for 9 min at 37oC thermo incubator.
Aspirate and discard 180 μl of supernatant

steps.title: Place islet in PBS
steps.instruction: Manually place one islet into each well of a 96‑well plate containing 100 µL PBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 200 g
steps.instruction: Spin the plate at 200 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Remove supernatant (80 µL)
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 80 µL of supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Add pre‑warmed Trypsin
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of pre‑warmed 0.05 % Trypsin to each well.

steps.title: Digest islets
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C for 9 min.

steps.title: Trituration of islets
steps.instruction: Near the end of incubation, pipette 80 µL up and down 12 times per well.

steps.title: Stop digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL PBS containing 10 % FBS to each well and pipette‑mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 400 g (first)
steps.instruction: Spin the plate at 400 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Remove supernatant (150 µL)
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 150 µL of supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Wash with PBS+10%FBS
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL PBS + 10 % FBS to each well and pipette‑mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 400 g (second)
steps.instruction: Spin the plate at 400 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Remove supernatant (100 µL)
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 100 µL of supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Add cold methanol
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL cold methanol to each well and incubate at –20 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 800 g, 4 °C
steps.instruction: Spin the plate at 800 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove methanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 100 µL of supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Wash with buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL wash‑resuspension buffer (3×SSC + 0.5 % BSA + 0.2 U/µL RNase inhibitor + 1 mM DTT) to each well, pipette‑mix three times.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Spin the plate at 800 g for 6 min.

steps.title: Aspirate final supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 180 µL of supernatant from each well.
